name: BULLET_ST_FLY
meaning: SetState 1: anim RUN, visible; Update: homes on the Wolf, -> 2 within 0x6e, -> 5 if he is dead (inferred)

name: BULLET_ST_HIT
meaning: SetState 2: anim ACTION, records the yaw offset around the Wolf; Update: sticks, -> 3 on anim end (inferred)

name: BULLET_ST_ORBIT_KILL
meaning: SetState 3: anim ACTION1, MSG_KILL arg 7 to the Wolf, msg 0x6f to Elmer; Update: circles the Wolf (inferred)
